title: Practice
description: Three graded exam-style file handling questions covering advanced file patterns.

questions.title: Practice 1 - Read File into Array
questions.task: A file called Scores.txt stores up to 100 integer scores, one per line. Write pseudocode to read all scores into an array called Scores and store the number of scores read in Count.
expectedThinking: Use an array to store file values
Use Count as both record counter and array index

assessment.expectedAnswer:
DECLARE Scores : ARRAY[1:100] OF INTEGER
DECLARE Count : INTEGER

Count <- 0

OPENFILE "Scores.txt" FOR READ

WHILE NOT EOF("Scores.txt")
    Count <- Count + 1
    READFILE "Scores.txt", Scores[Count]
ENDWHILE

CLOSEFILE "Scores.txt"

questions.title: Practice 2 - Filter and Write File
questions.task: A file called Marks.txt stores one mark per line. Write pseudocode to read all marks and write only the marks below 50 to a file called Retake.txt.
expectedThinking: Use EOF to process all marks
Use IF to filter marks below 50

assessment.expectedAnswer:
DECLARE mark : INTEGER

OPENFILE "Marks.txt" FOR READ
OPENFILE "Retake.txt" FOR WRITE

WHILE NOT EOF("Marks.txt")
    READFILE "Marks.txt", mark

    IF mark < 50 THEN
        WRITEFILE "Retake.txt", mark
    ENDIF
ENDWHILE

CLOSEFILE "Marks.txt"
CLOSEFILE "Retake.txt"

questions.title: Practice 3 - Multi-field Records
questions.task: A file called Students.txt stores each student's name and mark on each record. Write pseudocode to read all records and output the names of students who scored 80 or more.
expectedThinking: READFILE must read name and mark together
Use EOF to process all records
Output name only when the condition is true

assessment.expectedAnswer:
DECLARE studentName : STRING
DECLARE mark : INTEGER

OPENFILE "Students.txt" FOR READ

WHILE NOT EOF("Students.txt")
    READFILE "Students.txt", studentName, mark

    IF mark >= 80 THEN
        OUTPUT studentName
    ENDIF
ENDWHILE

CLOSEFILE "Students.txt"
